verdict.rationale: Datadog documents two in-product AI features: Bits AI, its AI assistant, and Watchdog, its AI-driven anomaly and insight detection. A community comment also cites outlier analysis as a key advantage, which supports the core of the story. One critic says users sift through dashboards instead of being shown anomalies, but this is general sentiment rather than a concrete failure of these features. missing for 10: substantive doc content beyond page titles describing what insights and suggestions Bits AI and Watchdog generate, hands-on corroboration of AI-generated suggestions in practice.
